root_cause: Before #3969, tools/ci/** was classified as non-deployable only after Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback had already admitted the main push and allocated runners. During the live-proof prerequisite run, the material writeback guard also used a three-dot diff in a shallow checkout, so separately fetched base/head commit objects could exist without a discoverable merge base and the guard failed before semantic evaluation.

prevention.material_writeback_diff: Use exact two-tree git diff --name-only <base> <head>; changed-path classification does not require commit ancestry.

evaluation.expected_final_proof: A successor containing only production-ignored paths produces no Production Source Snapshot or Production Release Readback run on its protected-main merge SHA.
